Paradox Interactive names new CEO
Paradox Interactive's current CEO, Fredrik Wester, is retiring after having taken the reins again, passing on duties to deputy CEO Mattias Lilja.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
November 16, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
via Paradox Interactive
Newsbrief:
Paradox Interactive has named
deputy CEO Mattias Lilja as the new CEO to replace a retiring Fredrik Wester beginning in January 2027.
Wester originally retired in 2018 and handed the reins over to Ebba Ljungerud, but Ljungerud left a few years later citing "differing views on the company's strategy going forward" leading to Wester's return to the role. Since then, Wester and Lilja have been leading the company together, briefly drawing worker outcry after
instituting a return-to-office mandate in 2025
.
For more information, be sure to visit
Paradox's website
.
